description: Fires in crowded late-middlegame boards (several columns full) where the left edge column 0 is still open: most strongly when column 0 has exactly one empty cell left, also when column 0 is empty or nearly empty while 3+ other columns are full. Never fires once column 0 is full, or when an immediate win or must-block exists. Many such boards still do not fire; the rule is partial.
effect: Small: forcing it high raises the probability of column 0 by about 2-8 points; zeroing it lowers column 0 by about 7-11 points (mass moves to other legal columns).
notes: Best dev F1 0.326 (P .25, R .48, AUROC .71), sim share 0.29 (p4). Column-0 height 5 alone: F1 .25. Tried height-spread/wells (F1 .14), few legal moves (.23), poisoned column under an opponent threat (.16), additive scores (.29), last stone in top rows (.25). Band histograms: col0 height 5 in 70% of top-band samples vs 2% of band 1; full col 0 only in band 0. Minimal pairs confirm col 0 reaching height 5 raises it and filling col 0 crashes it, but toy boards with col0 height 5 do not fire and activation is order/parity sensitive. Looks like a distributed 'column 0 still playable late' signal mixed with other things; possibly a random direction.
